svg.title: Two-frequency photoconductor noise comparison
svg.desc: A linear noise amplitude spectral density axis compares two measured frequencies for two illustrative detectors. Detector A is nearly flat. Detector B has substantially higher noise at the lower frequency. Only the two measured points are shown.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One reference value can hide low-frequency excess noise

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Linear NASD axis. Only the two comparison measurements are plotted; no spectral law is inferred.
